perfil_usuario.css: body { background: #00030F; color: white; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; } .aside{ display: flex; } .aside_list ul{ list-style-type: none; } .aside_list ul li a{ text-decoration: none; color: white; } .aside_list ul .perfil a{ border: solid; border-top: 0; border-right: 0; border-left: 0; border-color: #63C9BB; } .container { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; gap: 20px; padding: 20px; } .card { background: #000000; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: solid; border-color: #63C9BB; } .card h3 { margin-top: 0; } .tag { display: inline-block; background: #0f766e; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 12px; margin: 2px; } .header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 20px; background: #00030F; } .menu a { margin: 0 15px; color: white; text-decoration: none; } .menu a.active { background: #00ff88; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: black; } input, textarea { width: 100%; padding: 6px; margin: 5px 0; border-radius: 6px; border: none; } button { background: #00ff88; color: black; padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 5px; }
perfil_usuario.javascript: function salvarPerfil(){ var dados = { nome: document.getElementById('nome').value, email: document.getElementById('email').value, whatsapp: document.getElementById('whatsapp').value, sobre: document.getElementById('sobre').value }; if(window.parent) { window.parent.postMessage({payload: dados}, "*"); } alert("Perfil atualizado!"); }
